lessons.title: A fresh start: what your shahada means
lessons.hook: You just made the biggest decision of your life. Let's make sense of it.

lessons.title: Getting ready to pray: wudu, times and direction
lessons.hook: Five times a day, you'll have a few minutes with Allah. Today you get ready.

lessons.title: Your first prayer
lessons.hook: You don't need to know Arabic to pray today. You need the moves and a few words.

lessons.title: Telling your family (or not yet)
lessons.hook: You don't owe anyone an announcement. But when you're ready, there are kind ways to say it.

lessons.title: Praying when you're not alone
lessons.hook: You can pray almost anywhere. Here's how to do it at home, at work and at school, even if nobody knows yet.

lessons.title: Who Allah is
lessons.hook: Not a cop waiting for you to slip. Someone closer to you than you think.

lessons.title: Your masjid and your people
lessons.hook: There's only one first visit. After that, it's just your masjid.

lessons.title: Slow and steady
lessons.hook: You don't have to do everything this week. Here's what matters now, and what can wait.

lessons.title: You're still you
lessons.hook: Islam is a faith, not a costume. You don't have to become someone else.

lessons.title: Making Muslim friends
lessons.hook: Lots of converts say the hardest part isn't the rules. It's being alone.

lessons.title: Friday: Jumu'ah
lessons.hook: Once a week, the whole community prays together. Here's what happens, so you can walk in ready.

lessons.title: Iman goes up and down
lessons.hook: Some days your faith will feel bright. Some days it'll feel flat. Both are normal, and a flat day doesn't mean you're leaving.

lessons.title: What Muslims eat (and don't)
lessons.hook: Most of what you already eat is fine. Here are the few limits, and how to handle a family meal.

lessons.title: When family pushes back
lessons.hook: They might be hurt, scared or angry. You can stay kind and stay Muslim at the same time.

lessons.title: Meet the Prophet ﷺ
lessons.hook: You say his name in every prayer. Today, meet the man.

lessons.title: Too much advice
lessons.hook: Three people, three different answers. Here's how to stay calm and know who to ask.

lessons.title: Staying clean: ghusl and the basics
lessons.hook: Some of today is personal. All of it is simple, and every adult Muslim learns it.

lessons.title: Building your circle
lessons.hook: You don't need a crowd. You need one mentor, one friend and one class.

lessons.title: The Qur'an: where to start
lessons.hook: You already know two chapters by heart. Here's how to meet the rest.

lessons.title: Everyday Muslim words
lessons.hook: Five short phrases, and you'll understand half of what you hear at the masjid.

lessons.title: Mistakes and starting again
lessons.hook: Missed a prayer? Slipped up? Here's the way back, and it's always open.

lessons.title: Praying with the congregation
lessons.hook: Walking in late, not sure what to do? By the end of today, you'll know exactly how to join.

lessons.title: Your story
lessons.hook: Someone will ask why you became Muslim. You can answer in a minute, kindly, without freezing.

lessons.title: Muslim at work and school
lessons.hook: You can pray at work or school without making it a big scene. Most of it is planning and one calm conversation.

lessons.title: When the honeymoon ends
lessons.hook: If Islam feels less exciting than it did in week one, nothing is wrong with you. You're right on schedule.

lessons.title: Did my prayer count?
lessons.hook: Did I break my wudu? Did I pray three or four? Here's how to stop second-guessing every prayer.

lessons.title: Jesus and Mary in Islam
lessons.hook: "So you don't believe in Jesus anymore?" You do. Here's what Muslims believe, and how to say it kindly.

lessons.title: "So what do Muslims believe?"
lessons.hook: A friend asks what Muslims actually believe. You can answer in thirty seconds, in plain words.

lessons.title: Your rhythm
lessons.hook: Five prayers can feel like five interruptions, or like the frame your day hangs on. Let's build the frame.

lessons.title: Phase 1 complete
lessons.hook: Thirty days ago you learned your first words of prayer. Today you can pray the whole thing.

lessons.title: The map: Islam, Iman, Ihsan
lessons.hook: One short conversation, long ago, maps out the whole religion.

lessons.title: One God: tawhid
lessons.hook: "One God" sounds simple. It changes everything.

lessons.title: Hard questions are allowed
lessons.hook: A doubt doesn't mean you made a mistake. It means you're thinking.

lessons.title: Getting to know Allah by His names
lessons.hook: You can't love someone you don't know. Allah tells you who He is through His names.

lessons.title: Being the Muslim in your family
lessons.hook: You might be the only Muslim at the table for years. That's not a problem to solve. It's a long game.

lessons.title: Angels
lessons.hook: Forget the greeting-card cherubs. The angels in Islam are something else.

lessons.title: The books: Torah, Gospel, Qur'an
lessons.hook: There's a Bible on your family's shelf and a Qur'an on yours. Here's how Muslims see both.

lessons.title: Hijab and modesty
lessons.hook: Everyone seems to have an opinion about hijab. Here's what Islam actually says, and how real people get there.

lessons.title: The messengers: one message, Adam to Muhammad ﷺ
lessons.hook: You didn't join a new religion. You joined the oldest message there is.

lessons.title: Why Muslims pray a little differently
lessons.hook: The man next to you prays with his arms at his sides. Is one of you doing it wrong? Probably not.

lessons.title: The Last Day
lessons.hook: Everything you do matters, and Allah's mercy is bigger than you think.

lessons.title: Marriage: no rush
lessons.hook: Marriage is a beautiful part of Islam. It isn't a deadline, and nobody gets to rush you.

lessons.title: Destiny (qadar)
lessons.hook: Some things you control. Some things you don't. Islam gives you a way to live with both.

lessons.title: How fasting works
lessons.hook: Fasting sounds intense. Once you know how a fast day actually works, it's very doable.

lessons.title: Running on empty
lessons.hook: Tired, stretched thin, or low for a while? That's worth taking seriously, and getting help is part of faith.

lessons.title: Zakat and giving
lessons.hook: Zakat might not apply to you yet. Giving does, starting today, in any amount.

lessons.title: Hajj and Umrah
lessons.hook: Millions of people in simple white, from every country, answering the same call. One day, maybe you.

lessons.title: When Muslims let you down
lessons.hook: Someone at the masjid was harsh, or cold, or just plain rude. It hurts. It isn't Islam.

lessons.title: Halal by default
lessons.hook: If it feels like everything is haram, here's the truth: most things are allowed.

lessons.title: Dry spells
lessons.hook: Prayer feels like a routine and your heart feels quiet. Here's how to bring it back to life.

lessons.title: Food in real life
lessons.hook: Ingredient lists, restaurant menus, Sunday dinner at Mom's. Eating halal without making every meal a fight.

lessons.title: Facing Islamophobia
lessons.hook: A stare, a comment, a headline thrown at you. How to stay safe, keep your dignity, and know you're not alone.

lessons.title: Money: interest and debt
lessons.hook: Student loans, a car payment, a credit card. If you've heard "interest is haram" and started to panic, start here.

lessons.title: If you're struggling with something
lessons.hook: Drinking, weed, porn, vaping, gambling: a habit that came with you into Islam. You're not a fake. Here's how to keep going.

lessons.title: Is this still right for me?
lessons.hook: Almost two months in, a harder question can show up. It's allowed. Let's look at it honestly.

lessons.title: Men, women and boundaries
lessons.hook: Coworkers, classmates, the person in your DMs. Islam doesn't ask you to avoid half the world. It asks for some clear lines.

lessons.title: Extra prayers
lessons.hook: You've got the five. Now meet the extras the Prophet ﷺ kept around them, and learn witr in full.

lessons.title: Prayer on the go
lessons.hook: A road trip, a hospital bed, no sink in sight. Prayer comes with you, and Allah made it easier for exactly these days.

lessons.title: Modesty, a few months on
lessons.hook: Maybe you started hijab, or stopped. Maybe you're growing a beard and your family hates it. Wherever you are, let's talk honestly.

lessons.title: Phase 2 complete
lessons.hook: Sixty days. Today you find out how much you can explain, in your own words, to someone who asks.

lessons.title: Ihsan: worship as if you see Him
lessons.hook: You know how to pray now. Today is about praying, and living, with your whole heart in it.

lessons.title: Intention: who is this for?
lessons.hook: Same prayer, same post, same favor. What makes it count is who you're doing it for.

lessons.title: Words that build
lessons.hook: Group chats, gossip, little lies to get through the day. Your tongue is where character shows first.

lessons.title: Patience and gratitude
lessons.hook: Some weeks go well and some fall apart. Islam gives you a move for both.

lessons.title: Honoring your parents
lessons.hook: Becoming Muslim didn't make you owe your parents less. It made you owe them more.

lessons.title: Marriage and spouses
lessons.hook: Not how to get married. What a good Muslim marriage actually looks like, day to day.

lessons.title: Neighbors and coworkers
lessons.hook: Most people will never read a book about Islam. They'll just live next to you, or work with you.

lessons.title: Earning halal
lessons.hook: Your paycheck can be worship too. Here's how to keep it clean.

lessons.title: Anger and conflict
lessons.hook: Someone at the masjid corrects you rudely. Your mom mocks your prayer. Here's what to do in the next ten seconds.

lessons.title: Family over the long haul
lessons.hook: You'd love your family to know what you've found. Here's how to share it without pushing them away.

lessons.title: Tough questions, calm answers
lessons.hook: Someone asks the hard question. You don't have to win. You just have to stay calm and kind.

lessons.title: Don't become the judge
lessons.hook: The more you learn, the easier it is to notice what everyone else is doing wrong. Let's talk about that.

lessons.title: The Prophet's character ﷺ
lessons.hook: You've learned how he prayed. Today: how he treated people, especially people who hurt him.

lessons.title: Muslims in America: a long story
lessons.hook: You're not the first American to find Islam. Not even close.

lessons.title: Hard questions, three months in
lessons.hook: The questions that come at month three are sharper. That's not a bad sign. It means you're taking this seriously.

lessons.title: Islam online: who to trust
lessons.hook: Your feed has figured out you're Muslim. Some of what it shows you is gold. Some of it is noise, or worse.

lessons.title: Grief and loss
lessons.hook: Loss comes to everyone. Here's what Islam offers when it comes to you, including when the person you lost wasn't Muslim.

lessons.title: The four schools and their imams
lessons.hook: Four scholars, four cities, one chain of teachers and students. Meet the people behind the madhabs.

lessons.title: The Muslim year
lessons.hook: Muslims live by two calendars: the one at work, and the one the moon keeps. Today you learn the second.

lessons.title: Serving others
lessons.hook: Eighty days ago, you needed help with everything. Now you have something to give.

lessons.title: Keep learning
lessons.hook: Nine days to go. The learning doesn't stop at Day 90, and that's good news.

lessons.title: The Qur'an in your life
lessons.hook: You don't have to read the whole Qur'an this year. You just need to open it often.

lessons.title: Allah's mercy is bigger
lessons.hook: If you've been worried you're not good enough for Allah, this one is for you.

lessons.title: Music, movies and fun
lessons.hook: Being Muslim doesn't mean giving up fun. It means choosing it well.

lessons.title: Your story, in two minutes
lessons.hook: Someone asks, "Why Islam? What do you even believe?" Today you answer it, start to finish.

lessons.title: Pray with confidence
lessons.hook: Alone, at the masjid, or walking in late: today you check that you've got it.

lessons.title: Your people
lessons.hook: An app can't hug you on Eid. Today you map the people who can.

lessons.title: Du'a for everything
lessons.hook: Big or small, any language, any time. Allah is listening.

lessons.title: Your plan after Day 90
lessons.hook: Tomorrow is Day 90. Today you decide what Day 91 looks like.

lessons.title: Day 90
lessons.hook: Ninety days. You did this, one small day at a time.

lessons.title: Three letters, one shape: baa, taa, thaa
lessons.hook: Your first Arabic letters: one shape, three sets of dots.

lessons.title: Same tooth, new dots: nuun and yaa
lessons.hook: Two more letters that start with the same little tooth.

lessons.title: The cup family: jiim, Ḥaa, khaa
lessons.hook: One cup shape, three very different sounds.

lessons.title: Letters that don't hold hands: daal, dhaal, raa, zaay
lessons.hook: Four letters that never join to the letter after them.

lessons.title: Teeth and loops: siin, shiin, Ṣaad, Ḍaad
lessons.hook: Two pairs, and your first heavy letters.

lessons.title: Tall sticks and the throat: Ṭaa, Ẓaa, ʿayn, ghayn
lessons.hook: Two tall letters, and the sound English doesn't have.

lessons.title: Loops and tall letters: faa, qaaf, kaaf, laam
lessons.hook: Two loops and two tall letters, including two kinds of k.

lessons.title: The last five: miim, haa, waaw, alif, hamza
lessons.hook: The final five letters, and the whole alphabet is yours.

lessons.title: Three small marks: a, i, u
lessons.hook: The tiny marks that tell you which vowel to say.

lessons.title: Stop and double: sukun and shadda
lessons.hook: Two more marks: one says stop, one says double.

lessons.title: Long vowels and joining letters
lessons.hook: Stretch a vowel, join the letters, read a word.

lessons.title: Your first verses: Bismillah and al-Hamdu lillah
lessons.hook: Read the first two verses of al-Fatiha, word by word.

lessons.title: Eid al-Adha: Ibrahim's story and the sacrifice
lessons.hook: Eid Mubarak! Today's festival goes back to Ibrahim, a father, a son, and a trust in Allah that changed history.

lessons.title: Eid morning
lessons.hook: Eid Mubarak! Today you celebrate. Here's how the morning goes, and how not to spend it alone.

lessons.title: The best ten days of the year
lessons.hook: Dhul Hijjah has begun: the ten best days of the year. You don't have to be in Makkah to share in them.

lessons.title: The Day of Arafah
lessons.hook: Today, millions stand on one plain asking Allah for everything. You can ask with them.

lessons.title: Christmas with family
lessons.hook: "Are you coming home for Christmas?" Yes, you can. Here's how to be there, keep your faith, and keep the peace.

lessons.title: A family table: gratitude, food, and being there
lessons.hook: Thanksgiving is in a few days. You can be at that table as a Muslim, warmly. Here's how.

lessons.title: Ramadan is coming
lessons.hook: Your first Ramadan is about two weeks away. Here's what it is and what it asks of you.

lessons.title: Getting ready for Ramadan
lessons.hook: Ramadan starts in about three days. A simple plan now makes the first fast much easier.

lessons.title: Your first fast, hour by hour
lessons.hook: Today you fast. Here's exactly how the day goes, from the alarm to the first sip of water.

lessons.title: Night prayers, the Qur'an, and iftar together
lessons.hook: Ten days in. Tonight: the night prayer, the Qur'an, and why you shouldn't break your fast alone.

lessons.title: The last ten nights
lessons.hook: Somewhere in the next ten nights is one night better than a thousand months. Here's how to look for it.

lessons.title: Zakat al-Fitr and getting ready for Eid
lessons.hook: Eid is a few days away. One small charity to give first, then a plan for your first Eid.

lessons.title: Arabia and the House of Ibrahim
lessons.hook: Long before Islam, a valley in the desert already had a House built for one God.

lessons.title: The Year of the Elephant
lessons.hook: An army with an elephant marched on the Ka'bah. It never arrived. That same year, a boy named Muhammad was born.

lessons.title: Halimah and the desert
lessons.hook: No nurse wanted the orphan. The one who took him found her whole year changed.

lessons.title: Orphaned twice
lessons.hook: By eight, he had lost his father, his mother and his grandfather.

lessons.title: Shepherd, trader, and a pact for justice
lessons.hook: Before anyone called him a prophet, they called him "the trustworthy".

lessons.title: Khadijah
lessons.hook: She was a successful businesswoman. She hired him, watched him, and then she proposed.

lessons.title: The Black Stone
lessons.hook: Four clans were ready to fight over who would lift one stone. He found a way for all of them to lift it.

lessons.title: Hira: "Read!"
lessons.hook: A man alone in a mountain cave is told to read. He answers that he can't.

lessons.title: The pause, and "Arise and warn"
lessons.hook: After the first revelation, silence. Then the angel appeared again.

lessons.title: The first believers
lessons.hook: The first people to believe him knew him best: his wife, his best friend, a boy in his house and a man he had freed.

lessons.title: The call from Mount Safa
lessons.hook: He climbed a hill and asked whether they'd believe him if he warned of an army behind it.

lessons.title: Faith under pressure
lessons.hook: They left Bilal in the burning sun. He kept saying one word: One.

lessons.title: Refuge with a just king
lessons.hook: Persecuted at home, a group of Muslims fled across the sea to a Christian king.

lessons.title: Hamzah and 'Umar
lessons.hook: Two of Makkah's strongest men, a famous hunter and a feared opponent, joined the Muslims one after the other.

lessons.title: The boycott
lessons.hook: For about three years, his whole clan was shut out: no trade, no marriage, barely any food.

lessons.title: The Year of Sorrow
lessons.hook: In one year he lost the wife who believed him first and the uncle who shielded him.

lessons.title: Ta'if: the hardest day
lessons.hook: He walked to another town to ask for help. They chased him out with stones. Then an angel offered revenge.

lessons.title: The Night Journey and the gift of prayer
lessons.hook: In one night he was taken to Jerusalem and up through the heavens, and came back with the five prayers you pray today.

lessons.title: Strangers from Yathrib
lessons.hook: The people of Makkah turned him away. A handful of pilgrims from a farming town said yes.

lessons.title: The night he left
lessons.hook: Assassins waited at his door. In his bed lay his young cousin.

lessons.title: The cave and the road
lessons.hook: The trackers stood at the cave's mouth. One sentence kept two hunted men calm: Allah is with us.

lessons.title: Arrival: Quba and the camel that knelt
lessons.hook: Every morning for days, a whole town walked out to wait for one traveller.

lessons.title: Building a community
lessons.hook: The first thing he built was a masjid. The second was a brotherhood.

lessons.title: A call and a direction
lessons.hook: The adhan you hear five times a day began as a dream. The direction you pray changed in the middle of a prayer.

lessons.title: Badr
lessons.hook: A little over three hundred against about a thousand. Before anything else, he turned to the qibla and raised his hands.

lessons.title: Uhud
lessons.hook: They were winning. Then a group left their post, and everything turned.

lessons.title: The Trench
lessons.hook: Ten thousand soldiers marched on Madinah. The Muslims dug a ditch, hungry, with their Prophet ﷺ digging beside them.

lessons.title: A rumour about Aisha
lessons.hook: A necklace went missing, a caravan left without her, and a lie spread through Madinah for a month.

lessons.title: Hudaybiyah
lessons.hook: He let them strike "Messenger of Allah" from the treaty. His Companions were crushed. Allah called it "a clear conquest".

lessons.title: Letters to kings
lessons.hook: A man who couldn't read sent letters to the emperors of Rome and Persia.

lessons.title: Khaybar
lessons.hook: A fortress town, a flag for a man with sore eyes, and a meal that was poisoned.

lessons.title: Mu'tah
lessons.hook: He named three commanders in order, in case each fell. Then he told the news with tears before any messenger arrived.

lessons.title: Makkah opened
lessons.hook: He came back to the city that drove him out, at the head of ten thousand, and took no revenge.

lessons.title: Hunayn and the Ansar
lessons.hook: The biggest Muslim army yet nearly broke in a valley ambush. Afterwards, the people who had given most felt left out.

lessons.title: Tabuk, and Ka'b's honesty
lessons.hook: He had no excuse for staying home. Everyone else lied. He told the truth, and waited fifty days.

lessons.title: The Year of Delegations
lessons.hook: Tribe after tribe arrived in Madinah to meet him. Islam spread by visits, not by armies.

lessons.title: The Farewell Pilgrimage
lessons.hook: One Hajj, one sermon, and a verse that said the religion was complete.

lessons.title: His last days
lessons.hook: Too weak to lead the prayer, he sent for Abu Bakr. His last words were about prayer and the people in your care.

lessons.title: The day he died
lessons.hook: 'Umar refused to believe it. Abu Bakr walked in, kissed his face, and steadied a whole community with one sentence.

lessons.title: His family
lessons.hook: A father of four daughters, a grieving parent, a grandfather who kissed his grandsons in public.

lessons.title: His character, and loving him today
lessons.hook: His servant of ten years never once heard "Why did you do that?" You never met him, and he longed to meet you.

lessons.title: You're back. That's what counts.
lessons.hook: You've been away a few days. No guilt trip here. Let's just pick up where you are.

lessons.title: A gentle restart
lessons.hook: It's been a while. You don't have to explain, and you don't have to catch up. You just start again from today.
